body:
So my trip begins as any other night getting together with friends at Es house. Then my friends and I go out and pick up about 15 doses of DOC  and they got one dose of DMT. The DOC had  5-7 mg dissolved into a sugar cube. We go back and I dose on 2 sugar cubes. That was mistake number 1. I get back to the house and have an abnormally fast come up (30 minutes) which takes me completely off guard. I shake it off and retreat to another room. I cant remember the entire night so from here on I will give key aspects.
I had a bad trip.
I heard my mother and father screaming and crying my name and I thought I saw police lights everywhere.
I layed down ad felt as if I was floating on a cloud in the air and pokemon were dancing around me which was pretty cool.
I thought my 62 200+ lbs friend was my puppy.
I tried driving a parked car in a garage with no key in the ignitition while naked to go get pizza.
The force fed me bars which didnt knock me out just made me senile and tripping which I blacked out for the rest.
I woke up the next morning to a lecture from my friends dad an explanation of the night and I went to temple for the first time in a long time still mildly tripping.
